question: Verify that the points $A(1,0,2)$, $B(3,2,4)$ and $C(5,4,6)$ are collinear using vectors.
explanation:
Step 1: Vector from $A$ to $B$
\(\overrightarrow{AB}=(3-1)\hat{i}+(2-0)\hat{j}+(4-2)\hat{k}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}\)
Step 2: Vector from $A$ to $C$
\(\overrightarrow{AC}=(5-1)\hat{i}+(4-0)\hat{j}+(6-2)\hat{k}=4\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+4\hat{k}\)
Step 3: Proportionality comparison
Clearly,
\(\overrightarrow{AC}=2\overrightarrow{AB}\)
Step 4: Collinearity conclusion
Since the vectors joining $A$ to the other two points are proportional, they have the same direction. Therefore, all three points lie on one straight line.
Final Answer
The points $A$, $B$ and $C$ are collinear.

options.B: $\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}=4\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$; hence the points are perpendicular.
options.D: $\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{AC}=4\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$; hence the points are not collinear.
